title: Short Term Scholarships Administered by NTU
program_type: Donor-funded merit and need-based undergraduate scholarship pool
description: Short Term Scholarships Administered by NTU is a pool of donor-funded scholarships for current undergraduates or freshmen at NTU who are on subsidised tuition fees, have performed well academically and meet the criteria specified by the donor. Award values range from S$3,000 to S$16,000 and each scholarship is tenable for one academic year. A single online application covers the whole pool; applicants are considered for the best scholarship they qualify for. Some awards are need-based and require income documentation, and depending on the donor recipients may be required to intern at the donor

title: African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA) Scholarship
program_type: University tuition-fee scholarship (merit-based, restricted to ARUA member-university students)
duration: Follows the degree programme the applicant is awarded for; the page does not publish a fixed award duration.
description: Lund University runs the ARUA Scholarship as part of its global scholarship programme for high-achieving African students who have demonstrated academic excellence at an ARUA member university. The award is selective and merit-based and covers a percentage of tuition fees up to a maximum of 90%, depending on the budget of the programme or faculty concerned; living costs are not covered. Applicants must first apply for an international degree programme at Lund University with Lund as first choice, then apply through a separate Lund scholarship portal that opens by email invitation in early Febr
